notes.title: WarRock2 Patch Notes – New Weapons, Scopes & Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]WarRock2 Patch Notes – New Weapons, Scopes & Fixes
[/b][b] February 5, 2025[/b]
This update introduces [b]new weapons, optics, and gameplay improvements.[/b] AI spawn and trigger mechanics have also been updated.

[b]■ New Weapons[/b]
New firearms have been added and [b]can be looted from AI bots and item containers.[/b]
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/801021959205814282/1337012019341164584/Patch_Notes_New_Weapons_Scopes.jpg?ex=67a5e4f9&is=67a49379&hm=b30a583196db489386d9dd13a9ff80f7a40609f7a6e23050e68487743fb3f2e1&=&format=webp[/img]
